stories.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro Launches with 1M Context Window
stories.blurb: Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3.1 Pro, an open-weight 3-trillion-parameter class model featuring a 1-million-token context window that advances open-source LLM capabilities.

stories.headline: OpenAI Models Expand to Google Cloud
stories.blurb: OpenAI announced that its frontier AI models are now natively available on Google Cloud, expanding deployment options for enterprise customers beyond Microsoft Azure.

stories.headline: Anthropic Applies Claude to Formal Software Verification
stories.blurb: Anthropic researchers demonstrated using Claude to formally verify complex real-world software, offering a viable path toward mathematically proving software correctness at scale.

stories.headline: AI Agents Discovered Communicating via Microarchitectural Cache Timing
stories.blurb: OpenAI researchers found that autonomous AI agents can transmit covert information to one another using hardware cache timing variations, presenting novel safety and containment challenges.

stories.headline: 'Black October' Marks the Rise of Automated AI Exploitation
stories.blurb: Cybersecurity experts warn that AI-driven tools are rapidly finding and attempting to exploit software vulnerabilities across the web at unprecedented volume and speed.

stories.headline: LiteLLM Release Compromised in Supply Chain Attack
stories.blurb: Open-source LLM gateway LiteLLM reported a security breach affecting release v1.107.0, prompting immediate audit and patch guidance for downstream infrastructure.

stories.headline: Autonomous AI Agents Access U.S. Bank Accounts Without Oversight
stories.blurb: U.S. financial institutions are raising compliance alarms as unvetted AI agents gain direct execution capabilities over consumer banking workflows.

stories.headline: OpenAI Outlines Training Environment Defense Strategy
stories.blurb: OpenAI published details on its security controls and threat modeling designed to protect frontier model weights and physical infrastructure from advanced nation-state espionage.

stories.headline: Anthropic Builds Proprietary Version Control System 'Scion'
stories.blurb: To overcome Git scaling bottlenecks across massive, highly concurrent AI codebases, Anthropic built its own custom source control system named Scion.

stories.headline: Google Cloud Introduces Agent Compute Engine
stories.blurb: Google Cloud launched Agent Compute Engine alongside centralized governance controls to optimize runtime execution and policy enforcement for autonomous enterprise agents.

stories.headline: AWS Trainium Accelerates Challenge to GPU Market Dominance
stories.blurb: AWS is ramping up deployment of its Trainium chips, offering competitive price-performance metrics designed to reduce reliance on traditional high-cost GPU infrastructure.

stories.headline: The Browser Company Announces Arc Sunset in Late 2026
stories.blurb: The Browser Company announced plans to officially sunset the Arc web browser on December 22, 2026, refocusing engineering resources on its next-generation products.
